title.zh: Blur 宣布关闭网站前端并停止匹配新 Blend 贷款
title.en: Blur to Shut Down Website Frontend and Stop Matching New Blend Loans

current_state.zh: Blur宣布将于11月12日关闭其网站前端，并停止Blend匹配新的NFT贷款，此举引发收藏者的欢呼，他们认为其免版税模式和代币激励损害了NFT市场。
current_state.en: Blur announced it will shut down its website frontend on Nov. 12 and stop Blend from matching new NFT loans, prompting cheers from collectors who blame its royalty-free model and token incentives for damaging the NFT market.

updates.title_zh: Blur 将于 11 月 12 日关闭前端并停止撮合新的 Blend 贷款；BLUR 暴跌逾 16%
updates.title_en: Blur to Shut Down Frontend and Stop Matching New Blend Loans on November 12; BLU
updates.what_changed_zh:
Blur 宣布将于 2026 年 11 月 12 日关闭其前端，其链上交易市场协议将继续运行，BLUR 仍将继续控制该协议的费率开关（fee switch）。其 NFT 借贷协议 Blend 将在同一天停止撮合新的贷款，借款人须在此日期前还款，否则将面临违约。

持有未平仓头寸的 Blend 借款人面临还款或违约的硬性截止期限，NFT 借贷市场也将失去其贷款撮合场所。Blur 表示随后将提供一个前端工具，供用户从 Blend 中提取资产。

公告发布后，据币安数据，BLUR 一度下探至 0.01410 USDT，随后回升至 0.01523 USDT，24 小时跌幅达 16.55%。Blur 曾于 2022 年 3 月完成 1100 万美元种子轮融资，投资方包括 Paradigm、eGirl Capital 和 0xMaki。
updates.what_changed_en:
Blur announced that it will shut down its frontend on November 12, 2026, while its on-chain marketplace protocol will remain operational and BLUR will continue to control the protocol's fee switch. Its NFT lending protocol, Blend, will stop matching new loans on the same date, and borrowers have until then to repay their loans or allow them to default.

Blend borrowers with open positions face a hard deadline to repay or default, and the NFT lending market loses the venue that matched its loans. Blur said it will subsequently provide a frontend tool for users to withdraw their assets from Blend.

Following the announcement, BLUR fell to a low of 0.01410 USDT before recovering to 0.01523 USDT, down 16.55% over 24 hours according to Binance data. Blur raised $11 million in a seed round in March 2022, with investors including Paradigm, eGirl Capital and 0xMaki.

updates.background_zh: Blur 是 2022 年 10 月在以太坊上推出的去中心化 NFT 交易市场与聚合器，主打零市场手续费，面向专业和高频交易者。Blend 于 2023 年 5 月推出，是一种点对点的永续 NFT 借贷协议，不依赖预言机、没有到期日，借款头寸可无限期持有直至被清算，利率由市场决定。
updates.background_en: Blur is a decentralized NFT marketplace and aggregator launched in October 2022 on Ethereum, aimed at professional and high-volume traders with zero marketplace fees. Blend, introduced in May 2023, is a peer-to-peer perpetual NFT lending protocol with no oracle dependencies and no expiries, allowing borrowing positions to remain open indefinitely until liquidated, with market-determined interest rates.
updates.market_impact_zh: 即时反应集中在 BLUR 上：据币安数据，其 24 小时下跌 16.55%，价格约为 0.01523 USDT。风险敞口主要落在 BLUR 持有者，以及抵押品或贷款条款与 Blend 绑定的 NFT 持有者身上——撮合业务关停使这一借贷场所消失，而链上交易市场协议和费率开关仍在运行；除 NFT 板块之外，来源未提及更直接的传导渠道。
updates.market_impact_en: The immediate reaction was concentrated in BLUR, which fell 16.55% over 24 hours to about 0.01523 USDT on Binance. Exposure sits with BLUR holders and NFT holders whose collateral or loan terms are tied to Blend, since the wind-down of matching removes that lending venue while the on-chain marketplace protocol and fee switch continue to operate; the source describes no direct transmission channel beyond the NFT sector.

updates.title_zh: 曾经的以太坊最大NFT市场Blur在交易量暴跌99%后即将关闭
updates.title_en: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增背景数据与关联事件：Blur月交易量从2023年3月约14.3亿美元峰值暴跌超99%至2026年3月不足700万美元；过去三年协议收入为零；Blur关闭紧随姊妹项目Blast于10月2日宣布关闭；BLUR跌超20%。
updates.what_changed_en: Added background data and related event: Blur's monthly trading volume collapsed over 99% from about $1.43B in March 2023 to under $7M in March 2026; zero protocol revenue over the past three years; the shutdown follows sister project Blast's Oct. 2 closure announcement; BLUR fell over 20%.
updates.current_state_zh: Blur将于2026年11月12日关闭网站前端并停止Blend新贷款撮合，链上合约继续运行且BLUR持有者仍控制费率开关；后续报道补充其月交易量较2023年峰值下跌逾99%至不足700万美元、三年无协议收入，且此前10天姊妹项目Blast已宣布关闭，BLUR跌超20%。此前Yuga Labs高管已建议用户撤销Blur合约授权。
updates.current_state_en: Blur will retire its website frontend and stop matching new Blend loans on November 12, 2026, while on-chain contracts remain operational and BLUR holders retain control of the fee switch; subsequent coverage adds that monthly volume fell over 99% from its 2023 peak to under $7M, with zero protocol revenue over three years, and that sister project Blast announced its own closure ten days earlier; BLUR fell over 20%. Yuga Labs executives had earlier urged users to revoke Blur contract approvals.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Blur, once the largest Ethereum NFT marketplace, will shut down its website on Nov. 12 and halt new Blend loans after monthly trading volume fell more than 99% from its 2023 peak, sending the BLUR token down over 20%.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Blur, once the largest Ethereum NFT marketplace, will shut down its website on Nov. 12 and halt new Blend loans after monthly trading volume fell more than 99% from its 2023 peak, sending the BLUR token down over 20%.
